source: doc/procedures/security-scan.md §5 sweep table — the machine-checkable subset: a class is listed for a scope only if it can apply to that scope's surfaces
note: Declared applicability, not coverage: listing a class here DEMANDS rows for it (critic/queue/check merge this with the classes observed in ledger rows), it does not assert any surface was reviewed. Fields on rows still live in the ledger (doc/security/coverage-ledger.json).

classes.injection: SQL/command/template/XSS injection into route handlers or query arguments
classes.availability: resource exhaustion / denial of service: unbounded reads, quadratic joins, no corpus ceiling
classes.web-protocol/auth: authentication and authorization gaps on mutating or data-exposing endpoints
classes.concurrency: race conditions / TOCTOU / last-byte synchronization on shared singletons
classes.parser-input: ingestion of attacker-controlled formats through vendored parsers (PDF, EPUB, GGUF); unbounded reads before magic-byte validation

note_scopes: data: no demand declared; at-rest review operator-local by design (procedure scan-scope note)
